title: under sink shelves
text: under sink shelves. I had purchased some pull out shelves for under the sink in the bathroom - I had mistakenly purchased metal framed shelves.  They rusted and are impossible to pull out.  Grrr. So I purchased these.  Solid plastic.  No rust.  Problem solved.  They are slightly shorter in height and slightly more narrow than the metal set, but I don't find that a problem. Husband put them together (two sets) in about 20 minutes.  I just installed them, so time will tell, but I have to say so far so good.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: KUSARKO Under Sink Organizers and Storage for Kitchen Bathroom, Medicine Cabinet Organizer, 2 Tier Shelf Organizer with Sliding Storage Drawer, Plastic Pull Out Pantry Organization and Storage
features: ✅【ORGANIZERS AND STORAGE】Are the sinks, bathroom desktops, kitchens, and many small open spaces in your home all in a mess and trouble finding things? The white pull-out double-layer pantry organizer can store things neatly and make it easy to take things.

✅【APPROPRIATE SIZE】Size: 9"W x 14.6"D x 15"H. The bottom layer can hold things up to 10 inches high. Don’t worry about not being able to accommodate something higher. Maximum load-bearing weight of pantry organization: 55 pounds.
✅【HIGH-HARDNESS PP PLASTIC】Due to the use of high-hardness PP plastic, it can be washed directly with water when the organizer is soiled, so don’t worry rusting!

✅【INSTALLATION-FREE AND STABLE STRUCTURE】 The shelf organizer adopts installation-free design, which can be assembled simply. The bottom foot pad makes it non-slip and stable when holding things. Drawers slid out effortlessly and carry supplies where you need them!

✅【WHERE CAN IT BE USED? 】Provide multi-functional storage in a compact space, such as kitchen, bathroom, sink and so on. You can put toiletries, kitchen supplies, and vegetables and fruits. It can be washed directly with water after being soiled!
